purpose: Separate exact reserve transaction phases on identical disposable filesystem copies; no production writes, paid calls or authority relocation.
maximum_seconds_scope: Between-cycle bound after drain; not a hard process interruption.
source_copy_policy: Compute agent owns ONE URI-ro consistent backup of the quiescent original ledger to localXFS, bounded paged backup/progress deadline. Close the production source before any copied workload. Freeze baseline hash, preserve baseline, then prepare two distinct-inode byte-identical copies. No second backup.
per_location_argv: Append --copy <boundcopy> --filesystem-label <location> --output <boundreport> only after actual baseline hash/source pins verified.
synthetic_settlement_policy: Unchanged AtomicBudget.reserve_attempt then settle with diagnostic-only IDs/metadata; original guardedrun/caps/journal/synchronous policy retained. Synthetic charges exist only in copies and are not API spending. Historical unknown count and full held amount must remain equal before/after.
materialization_policy: Record execute and fetch/materialization separately; no SQL parameter, request, prompt or response content in output.

tests.scope: Disposable fixtures only; original guard blocks, hashes/production path reject beforeconnect, all historicalholds preserved.

limits: Matched fresh copies share baseline bytes but do not reproduce original-file locks, page-cache history or fsync tails.
A fast NFS copy does not establish that production NFS or external readers were harmless.
A slow total alone does not identify NFS or provider cause.
No paid resumption, halt clearing, epoch reset or production ledger migration is authorized by this diagnostic.
